Seasoned Firewood, Cut From Our Own NE Ohio Tree Work

Chagrin Falls has been one of Roubic's Tier 1 service areas for years. The firewood we deliver comes straight from the hardwood we remove across Northeast Ohio — oak, ash, maple, and cherry that would otherwise go to waste. Chagrin Falls Local Knowledge

Local Hardwood, Properly Seasoned

Every load we deliver to Chagrin Falls is split from Northeast Ohio hardwood — oak, ash, maple, and cherry — and seasoned, typically six to twelve months, so the moisture is low enough to burn clean and hot. Properly seasoned wood lights easier, throws more heat, and leaves far less creosote than the green or freshly cut wood some sellers deliver.

Chagrin Falls's historic village lots often mean tight driveways and particular placement. We can drop your wood in an accessible spot, and stacking is available on request so it's ready where you want it.

Why Order Early

The Cost of Waiting — Chagrin Falls Firewood

Three reasons ordering seasoned firewood ahead of the season beats scrambling in January.

Seasoned Wood Sells Out

Properly seasoned hardwood is finite each year. Wait until the first cold snap and the dry, ready-to-burn wood is often already spoken for.

Green Wood Burns Poorly

Last-minute buyers frequently end up with unseasoned wood that hisses, smokes, throws less heat, and cakes the flue with creosote.

Peak-Season Delivery Backlog

Once winter hits, every wood supplier is booked. Ordering early keeps you inside our fast Tier 1 Chagrin Falls delivery window.

Common Chagrin Falls Firewood Questions

Chagrin Falls Firewood Delivery FAQ

Six things Chagrin Falls homeowners want to know before ordering firewood.

What kind of firewood does Roubic deliver in Chagrin Falls?
Seasoned local hardwood — primarily oak, ash, maple, and cherry — cut and split from the trees Roubic removes across Northeast Ohio. It's split to a standard length for fireplaces and wood stoves and seasoned so it's ready to burn when it arrives. Because we cut our own wood, there's no green filler in the load.
Do you deliver firewood to Chagrin Falls?
Yes. Chagrin Falls is one of Roubic's Tier 1 service areas, and firewood is delivered anywhere within our 40-mile radius from the Auburn Township yard. Orders are typically scheduled and delivered within one to two days during the fall and winter season.
How much does firewood cost in Chagrin Falls?
Roubic's seasoned hardwood runs $180–$450 per cord depending on wood type, quantity, and delivery. Face cords (about a third of a full cord) and bulk multi-cord orders are quoted by the cord. Delivery within the service radius is included — ask for the current per-cord rate when you order.
Is the firewood seasoned and ready to burn?
Yes. Our hardwood is split and seasoned, typically six to twelve months, so the moisture is low enough to burn clean and efficiently. Properly seasoned hardwood lights easier, produces more heat, and leaves far less creosote in the flue than green or freshly cut wood.
Do you stack the firewood or just drop it?
Standard delivery drops the split wood in your driveway or another accessible spot. Stacking is available on request for an added charge — helpful on Chagrin Falls's historic village lots where placement matters. Let Aaron know when you order and stacking will be quoted with the delivery.
How much firewood do I need — a face cord or a full cord?
A full cord is 128 cubic feet — a stack roughly 4 ft high, 4 ft deep, and 8 ft long. A face cord is about a third of that. A full cord usually covers a season of regular fireplace use, while heavy wood-stove households often order multiple cords. Not sure? Aaron can recommend a quantity based on how you burn.
